record.field: v = payslip.version_id if v and not v.l10n_ma_frais_pro_actif: result = 0.0 else: avn = (v.l10n_ma_avantage_logement + v.l10n_ma_avantage_voiture) if v else 0 base_frais = SBI - avn taux = float(v.l10n_ma_taux_frais_pro or '35') / 100.0 if v else 0.35 result = min(base_frais * taux, 35000.0 / 12.0)

v = payslip.version_id cnss = abs(CNSS_SAL) if CNSS_SAL else 0 amo = abs(AMO_SAL) if AMO_SAL else 0 cimr = 0 if v and v.l10n_ma_affilie_cimr and v.l10n_ma_taux_cimr: cimr = SBC * (v.l10n_ma_taux_cimr / 100.0) mut = v.l10n_ma_mutuelle if v else 0 result = SBI - FRAIS_PRO - cnss - amo - cimr - mut

v = payslip.version_id if v and v.l10n_ma_ir_exonere: result = 0.0 else: nb = v.l10n_ma_personnes_charge if v else 0 nb = min(nb, 6) charges = nb * 50.0 ir_du = IR_BRUT - charges result = -max(ir_du, 0.0)
